question: Does one additional public lead already contain enough native evidence and an open owner decision to start the N020 value test without a new learned-policy or hardware run?
verdict: No selected candidate qualifies. Keep N015 awaiting existing artifacts and owner access. Do not expand the engine or repeat these source checks without changed evidence.

scope.selection: Targeted public artifact-availability search; not representative incidence or demand measurement.
scope.inspection: Issue bodies, selected comments, two linked PR bodies and one PR diff. All fetched API response bytes have receipts; not all linked source files, reviews, datasets or attachments were inspected.

candidates.decision: TDMPC direct action-chunk behavior in the async server.
candidates.available: Self-contained random-model reproducer and PR 4872 at 8852cce4bd610293ad62d0d6342ebd9f0c82b7a9.
candidates.conventional_work: Author patch already handles cold queues and output layout. Reviewer tryu-ai reports server tests and the remaining warm custom-camera failure when combined with the separate encoder fix.
candidates.missing: No source-bound deployed checkpoint, recorded failure trajectory, owner value comparison or new decision delegated to Nisayon.

candidates.decision: Load YAML policy overrides without losing dictionary structure.
candidates.available: Source ff71cae, a local ACTConfig reproducer and PR 4845 at f8983a9045ef08688e792e4ba62c1dedfdbef35a.
candidates.conventional_work: The upstream patch emits dictionary overrides as JSON. The PR author reports 16 tests; a later reviewer reports actual ACTConfig readback and 20 combined passes. Those are external reports, not our replication.
candidates.missing: No additional owner deployment choice or measured avoidable work. Rerunning this known config fix would be software confirmation only.

candidates.decision: Prevent neighboring episode frames appearing after video conversion.
candidates.available: Original symptom report and discussion of a separate reproducible PyAV timestamp failure.
candidates.conventional_work: PR 4886 is linked for the timestamp failure. Its author explicitly does not claim to reproduce or fix the original overlap symptom.
candidates.missing: Original input clips, conversion command and environment sufficient to reproduce overlap. Do not replace the reported incident with the easier timestamp failure.

candidates.decision: Interpret robot-dataset audit exclusions and missing coverage.
candidates.available: Discussion links a public robot-data-audit 0.9.20 sweep and distinguishes five coverage outcomes. These external files were identified but not downloaded or reproduced in this intake.
candidates.conventional_work: Tool author already acknowledges that absent videos need the existing no-video mode and plans a clearer hint. Existing audit tools and retained survey records already address this workflow.
candidates.missing: An actual deployment correction decision and evidence that additional Nisayon checks save work. Dataset audit rows alone do not supply either.

candidates.decision: Report structural channel-name ambiguity without inferring semantics.
candidates.available: Issue body and latest review identify source-pinned metadata and an existing local prototype.
candidates.conventional_work: Reviewer already distinguishes missing, empty, count mismatch, ambiguity and unsupported layouts, with 15 reported synthetic tests. This intake read the body and selected comments, not every linked artifact or the full survey.
candidates.missing: A deployment incident linking metadata to a consequential owner choice; cardinality cannot establish channel meaning or downstream policy impact.

candidates.decision: Adopt static KV caching and compiled denoising on a particular deployment device.
candidates.available: Author-reported aggregate RTX 4090 timings and checkpoint name; a commenter offers a prospective Jetson comparison.
candidates.conventional_work: Static-cache remedy is already supplied. Discussion already distinguishes chunk prediction rate from control rate and identifies warm-up, Triton availability and memory as device-specific questions.
candidates.missing: Pinned proposed patch, retained native benchmark records, target device results and current owner decision. A CPU proxy cannot answer the Jetson deployment choice; no new GPU run is allocated.

candidates.decision: Address arm jitter through deployment timing, smoothing or training.
candidates.available: Source revision 4ea96a16b15cfdbbd787b6b4f519a12687281330, hardware description and image/video links. Attachments were not downloaded or measured.
candidates.conventional_work: A contributor already points to candidate deployment and RTC changes. The issue does not verify that either resolves the reported deployment.
candidates.missing: Numeric observation/action timestamps, bridge settings, fine-tuned artifact identity and current owner decision; a video alone cannot distinguish the proposed mechanisms.

decision.retain: N020 deployment-change qualification hypothesis and existing bounded tools.
decision.execute: Close this finite intake with retained source receipts and precise missing inputs; route a supplied native packet to conventional inspection first.
decision.do_not_allocate: Another literature survey, duplicate upstream patch, metadata linter, generic importer, backend or learned-policy experiment without a decision that can earn the work.
decision.resume_when: An owner supplies an existing log/config location and the current choice, or a selected lead publishes a relevant native trace. Bind only the source, checkpoint and runtime fields needed for that choice; keep missing fields explicit.
decision.first_packet_budget: At most one incident and four engineering/inspection hours, with no new policy, training, GPU or hardware run. This budget has not been consumed by a customer case.
decision.value_claim: Unresolved. No matched workflow comparison ran; absence of a qualifying case in this small search and brief nonresponse do not establish absent demand.

costs.measurement_limits: Request wall times overlap and are not elapsed session or engineer time. Bytes count retained application payload, not network traffic. Search/browser overhead, agent tokens, labor, review and future integration/maintenance were not fully measured; no savings ratio is supported.

validation.test_scope: Documentation and intake receipts only; no product code changed and no policy or software experiment was rerun.
